reason: Controls truthful reporting and selection of safe static/mocked checks versus separately authorized database, build, cron, and live operations.
Audit authentication order, user scoping, helper ownership, writes, errors, and revalidation across preview and confirmation.
Audit additive migration SQL, null compatibility, target authorization, rollback, and absence of destructive/reset behavior.
Audit exact userscript origins/grants, manual scan boundary, normalized-only transport, synthetic network denial, and live-operation authorization.
Check stable catalog-key propagation, existing-user fail-closed backfill, exact cycle modeling, and materialization interactions.
Defines route/component/mutation test matrices, accessibility assertions, strict TypeScript, targeted lint, and diff checks.
Check strict schemas, wire DTOs, generated enum ownership, unknown-input narrowing, and absence of unsafe casts.
Verify the implementation did not add credentialed CORS, weaken SameSite, use iframe transport, or grant privileged cookie/network access.
Verify exact top-level handoff, same userscript identity, one mailbox, query-only opaque locator, exact-origin handshake, and cleanup behavior.
Check V2 stable key/period coverage and all mapping, provenance, attempt, row-audit, nullable-key, and stale-replay gaps.
Check session-derived identity, strict route responses, per-row transactions, absolute authority, partial success, and idempotency against repository references.
Check the full security/migration/rollback/retention/telemetry test matrix and that operational actions remain explicitly skipped without authorization.
